description: 三位诺恩之一，与乌尔德、薇尔丹蒂共同参与命运秩序。
fullDescription: 来源没有要求把Skuld画成未来预言者或女武神。设计上可以用更前视、更锐利的姿态和未完成空间表达‘将来/应然’的联想，但必须保留诺恩身份，避免水晶球、预言UI和战士化。
roleInSeries: 完成三位诺恩的差异化视觉闭环。

sourceRefs.note: 点名三位诺恩并描述其命运职能。

visualThesis: 更前视、更警觉的诺恩，眼神与姿态向画外延伸，背景保留较多未完成空间。

interpretationNotes: Skuld=未来/应然是常见词义联想，不能等同于来源明确预言女神

mustKeep: 与另外两位共享朴素材质

instructions: 脸型、发型、服装轮廓必须独立

visual.detailHierarchy: 脸、眼神、手高细节；背景留白和软边。

prompt.draft: Create Skuld as a distinct Norn beside the world-tree spring, with a sharper forward-looking gaze and more reserved upright posture. She is not a Valkyrie, not a warrior and not a crystal-ball prophet. Use open or unfinished natural space as a subtle visual cue rather than literal future symbols. Make her face, hairstyle and silhouette clearly different from Urðr and Verðandi. Natural materials, restrained painterly style, crop-safe face and hands, low-detail background.
prompt.final:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Asset type: MythCanvas Norse M01 collectible-card source artwork.

Create ONE standalone portrait 9:16 pure artwork for card 1003010011, Skuld / 斯库尔德, type character.

This is an original mythological interpretation, not a copy of a modern franchise design.

The image must contain no typography, title, logo, card frame, number, watermark, pseudo-runes, UI, collage, split layout, contact sheet, or panels.

Content brief: Create Skuld as a distinct Norn beside the world-tree spring, with a sharper forward-looking gaze and more reserved upright posture. She is not a Valkyrie, not a warrior and not a crystal-ball prophet. Use open or unfinished natural space as a subtle visual cue rather than literal future symbols. Make her face, hairstyle and silhouette clearly different from Urðr and Verðandi. Natural materials, restrained painterly style, crop-safe face and hands, low-detail background.

Visual thesis: 更前视、更警觉的诺恩，眼神与姿态向画外延伸，背景保留较多未完成空间。

Identity anchors: 前视眼神；更锐利轮廓；独立脸型；留白/未完成空间

Must keep: 仍然是诺恩而非战士；与另外两位共享朴素材质；不持武器

Must avoid: 女武神盔甲；水晶球；预言UI；复制另外两位脸；科幻时间门

Composition: camera eye level; shot upright three-quarter; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Color and material guidance: palette 灰紫；深绿；骨白；冷灰; materials 粗织物；泉水；树根；石; mood alert；fateful；reserved；forward-looking.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 1003010009；1003010010. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: Valkyrie armor；weapon；crystal ball；prophecy UI；clock；Urðr clone；Verðandi clone；glossy game-CG；typography; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.

Fill one complete portrait 9:16 canvas with no margins. Target final canvas at least 1620x2880 pixels.
